explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 61 named tracks, releases and catalogue cuts across same-day Bristol bass/garage activity, September 11 raw/deep techno releases on We Are The Brave and Illegal Alien, a new Detroit-techno/IDM/electro album on Neo Ouija, current ARTS and SK_eleven material, and adjacent catalogue recommendations. Official and attributed written evidence only; no audio audition.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Extra Medium's September 12, 2026 My Sound supplied two exact same-day UK-garage/bass identities. https://thickboyrecords.bandcamp.com/album/my-sound

CURRENT TECHNO WINDOW: Procombo's September 11 Not Alone EP and Colomboi's September 11 Alchemy supplied exact raw/deep/hypnotic and groove/atmosphere leads from distinct current releases. https://wearethebraveofficial.bandcamp.com/album/not-alone-ep ; https://illegalalienrecords.bandcamp.com/album/alchemy
ADJACENT CURRENT WINDOW: Yunx's September 11 Iconiconical expanded the scan into a newly inspected Detroit-techno, IDM and electro field. https://neoouija.bandcamp.com/album/iconiconical

OVERLOOKED / EDGE WINDOW: current SK_eleven, ARTS, Kirril and Molekül pages plus their catalogue recommendations were inspected; previously handled Confusion, Sanskrit and Shez Kurx identities were excluded.
exclusions: Run 177 is REQUEST_NOT_COMPLETED because two placements contained a non-ledger URI; none of its nine identities was reused and its failed request remains immutable at commit da73af58b95ee6f1e0e1f656c16c1ab153f72a3c.
Runs 166–176 selected, alternate, unresolved and source identities were not recycled; previously handled Confusion, Sanskrit and Colomboi's unresolved title track were also excluded.
Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits and exact tracks already in the global utility ledger were excluded.

Nine honest leads survived without artist, texture or genre quotas. Every proposed URI pair was re-derived from the current 49-track ledger and programmatically checked for adjacency and prose agreement.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
